name: Mimic Reaction Time (General)
body:
You know how to emulate the reaction time of some of the fastest creatures alive.

Prerequisite(s): Shaped capacity class feature.

Benefit(s): By spending 1 moment of change you gain a circumstance bonus to your Initiative equal to one-third your class level for one encounter.
